name: The Library
_why: The plot calls it a city of bookshelves. It sits BETWEEN the Lounge (south, off the near edge) and the Anarchy Garden (north, through the bookcase wall) — the map in story.js decides that.
summary: A vast warm hushed library in a magical realm: floor-to-ceiling dark timber bookcases packed with old leather-bound books, their shelf lines running at the same height all the way across, lit by brass reading lamps glowing amber.
floor: many small warm sandy-grey flagstones in staggered courses with fine dark mortar joints, a warm mid-tone lit by candlelight, muted rather than bright, with mottling and wear

doors.look: ONE open arched doorway cut through the bookcases, lit soft green from beyond
the way back down to the Lounge

contains: a rolling library LADDER leaning against the bookcases on the left
a deep buttoned oxblood leather ARMCHAIR with a small round candle table beside it
a WRITING DESK with an open book and an inkwell
a patterned crimson reading RUG lying flat on the floor
